user_job: Change one repeating task: just this occurrence (retitle, reassign, move a day), this and future occurrences (including how it repeats), or every occurrence, without changing work already done.
personas_and_grants: WORKER, VIEWER: no edit entry; completion only

scope.subject: One open occurrence of a task series

entry_points: TaskDetailScreen Edit (open repeating occurrence, planner only)
navigation.deep_link_authorization: No deep link; entry hidden without MANAGE_WORKERS and TaskPlanning.edit refuses without it
navigation.back_and_draft_behavior: Back returns to the task; unsaved edits are discarded

ordered_sections: Task (title, due date for this occurrence or repeat for later scopes, assignee)

fields.label: Change
validation: THIS_AND_FUTURE at the first occurrence is sent as SERIES

fields.label: Repeat
fields.type: choice of RecurrenceKind (not NONE) or keep

fields.label: Assign to
validation: account must be on this farm

queries.name: open occurrence row
queries.loading_empty_error: Opened from a loaded row; errors shown on save

actions.label: Save changes
actions.intent: Edit the series at this occurrence
effects: THIS_AND_FUTURE: series ends the day before, new series continues
SERIES: series updated; completed rows unchanged
actions.idempotency: Journalled once per save; replay applies the same edit
actions.success_receipt: Returns to the task board with the change listed
